//: Type-checks the EDGE functions, which the root tsconfig deliberately excludes.
This exists because an undefined variable reached production and 500'd every
free-registration invite on both tenants for ~95 minutes (2026-08-19). The
checks that should have caught it were all blind: the file had @ts-nocheck,
the root tsc excludes this directory, and CI deployed with no type step.
Settings are deliberately permissive about TYPES and strict about EXISTENCE:
the goal is to catch identifiers and imports that do not exist, without
demanding a full type-clean rewrite of Deno code written against `any` shims.
